title: DNeasy PowerSoil Pro Kit Protocol for Increased Sediment Volume & Inhibitor Removal
author: Grayson Huston

steps.title: Prepare 0.5M EDTA, pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Prepare 250 mL of 0.5M EDTA, pH 8.0 solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 52.025 g Ethylenediamine Tetraacetic Acid, Tetrasodium Salt Dihydrate (EDTA) to a volumetric flask.
Add 200 mL DI water to dissolve.
Titrate to pH 8.0 using Hydrochloric Acid (HCL, approx. 9.5 mL).
Add DI water to bring the final volume to 250 mL.
Autoclave the solution.

steps.title: Prepare 1M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of 1M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 78.8 g Tris-HCl to a volumetric flask.
Add 400 mL DI water to dissolve.
Raise pH to 8.0 using 10 N NaOH.
Add DI water to bring the final volume to 500 mL.
Autoclave the solution.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5M Na2PO4*7H2O, pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Prepare 250 mL of 0.5M Na2PO4*7H2O, pH 8.0 solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 33.508 g Na2PO4*7H2O to a volumetric flask.
Add 200 mL DI water and heat to dissolve.
Raise pH to 8.0 using 10 N NaOH (approx. 1.5 mL).
Add DI water to bring the final volume to 250 mL.
Autoclave the solution.
Add 16 g NaOH to a volumetric flask.
Add 40 mL of DI water to dissolve.

steps.title: Mix Inhibitor Removal Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of Inhibitor Removal Wash Buffer (Final concentration: 10mM EDTA pH 8.0, 50mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 50mM sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate pH 8.0).

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 mL 0.5M EDTA (pH 8.0), 25 mL 1M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 50 mL Na2PO4*7H2O (pH 8.0), and 415 mL DI water.
Autoclave the solution.

steps.title: Wash Sediment Samples
steps.instruction: Wash sediment samples to remove inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Weigh sediment samples into a centrifuge-safe tube.
Add approximately 3x the volume of Wash Buffer to the sediment (e.g., add ~15 mL Wash Buffer for 5g sediment to account for loss during washing).
Vortex sample at maximum speed for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge at 1760 x g for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Repeat the vortex and centrifuge steps 3 to 4 times.

steps.title: Perform Mechanical Lysis
steps.instruction: Lysis of the washed sediment using PowerBead Pro Tubes.

substeps.instruction: Spin PowerBead Pro Tube briefly to settle beads at the bottom.
Add 0.5 g of washed sediment to the tube.
Add 800 µL Solution CD1 and vortex briefly to mix.
Secure tubes horizontally to a 1.5mL-2.0mL Vortex Adapter and vortex for 10 minutes.
Rotate tubes so caps are oriented in the opposite direction and vortex for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate and Add CD2
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate and perform the first chemical treatment.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge PowerBead Pro Tube at 15000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer all supernatant to a clean 2 mL Microcentrifuge Tube.
Add 200 µL of Solution CD2 and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Clarify and Add CD3
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate and perform the second chemical treatment.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer all supernatant to a clean 2 mL Microcentrifuge Tube.
Add 600 µL of Solution CD3 and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the lysate onto the MB Spin Column to bind DNA.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the lysate onto an MB Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the loading and centrifugation process until all lysate has passed through the column.
Carefully place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 mL Collection Tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA using Solutions EA and C5.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution EA to the column, centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute, discard flow-through, and return column to the same 2 mL Collection Tube.
Add 500 µL of Solution C5 to the column, centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute, discard flow-through, and place column into a new 2 mL Collection Tube.

steps.title: Dry the Membrane
steps.instruction: Remove residual wash buffer from the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16000 x g for 2 minutes.
Carefully place the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 mL Elution Tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the membrane using Solution C6.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Solution C6 to the center of the white membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute.
Pipette the liquid flow-through and re-add it to the center of the white membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 15000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the MB Spin Column.
